goal: Configure a container entirely from outside its image — override ENTRYPOINT and CMD with command/args, inject settings with env, envFrom and the downward API, and mount a JSON dataset — then diagnose a CrashLoopBackOff caused by one missing variable.
produces: An entrypoint-override matrix of three Pods proving how command and args map onto image ENTRYPOINT and CMD
A booking-config Pod driven by ConfigMaps built from data/route-defaults.env and data/tariff-rates.json
A CrashLoopBackOff diagnosis read from kubectl logs --previous and lastState.terminated.exitCode
concepts: command overrides ENTRYPOINT, args overrides CMD — and command alone discards CMD
env, envFrom (with prefix and optional), configMapKeyRef and the downward API fieldRef/resourceFieldRef
$(VAR) expansion inside env values and args happens in the kubelet, before the shell runs
CrashLoopBackOff is a back-off state, not an error: read exitCode and logs --previous
